defaults: retain prior display while pending, disable mock actions
success: Only admitted typed closed observation transitions to Closed and clears local mock controls; binding/document remain open
error: inert text, aria-live; no success toast, no automatic retry, no close of new preview
late: ignore old capture after navigation/reload/replacement/generation/epoch change; never close replacement preview
validation: no raw identity input or privilege carried in UI payload
accessibility: keyboard Close, focusable inline error summary
